scripts.dev:watch: concurrently "cd svelte-app && bun run dev:watch" "hugo serve --disableFastRender --forceSyncStatic" --names "VITE,HUGO" --prefix-colors "cyan,magenta"

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "hugo server -D" "cd svelte-app && bun run dev" "bash scripts_dev/pb-dev.sh" --names "HUGO,VITE,PB" --prefix-colors "magenta,cyan,green"
